title: Call Center: Greeting a Customer
description: Portable demo lesson generated with the English voice installed in Windows.

segments.text: Hello, thank you for calling customer service.
My name is Khaled. How can I help you today?
segments.translation: اسمي خالد. كيف يمكنني مساعدتك اليوم؟

segments.text: I understand your concern, and I will check that for you.
segments.translation: أتفهم مشكلتك، وسأتحقق من ذلك من أجلك.

segments.text: Thank you for your patience. Is there anything else I can help you with?
segments.translation: شكرًا لصبرك. هل يوجد شيء آخر يمكنني مساعدتك فيه؟

scriptLines: Hello, thank you for calling customer service.
